title: Technology Sector Update for 10/25/2018: GRUB, TWTR, AMD, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks:
MSFT: +5.03%
AAPL: +1.86%
IBM: -1.48%
CSCO: +2.70%
GOOG: +3.54%
Tech stocks were maintaining earlier gains through mid-day Thursday, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 ( XLK ) Tuesday adding more than 2.7% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (^SOX) was rising by 2%.
Moving stocks include:
(-) GrubHub ( GRUB ) was 11% lower even after the food ordering and delivery company announced a jump in Q3 non-GAAP net income, to $0.45 per diluted share from $0.28 per diluted share last year.
In other sector news:
(+) Twitter ( TWTR ) was advancing more than 14% after the social network company announced non-GAAP diluted earnings of $0.21 per share, more than double the $0.10 booked last year. The result topped the $0.14 mean from analysts polled by Capital IQ.
(-) Advanced Micro Devices' ( AMD ) fell 15% after it said adjusted EPS rose to $0.13 in Q3 from $0.09 a year earlier, just ahead of analysts' estimates of $0.12 in a Capital IQ poll. Its revenue lagged the Street estimate.
(+) Microsoft ( MSFT ) was up more than 5% after the software giant reported Q1 revenue was $29.1 billion, up 19% over year-ago levels and ahead of the analyst consensus of $27.9 billion on Capital IQ. Earnings were $1.14 per share, surging 36% over year ago levels and better than expectations of $0.96 per share.
